subject: Mitochondria as Brain Aging Hubs: Beyond Neurons
script: From Agewell Brief: Mitochondria as Brain Aging Hubs: Beyond Neurons. A new review maps how mitochondrial dysfunction spreads across brain cell types, revealing intercellular transfer as a metabolic lifeline and targeting mitochondria as a therapeutic frontier. Mitochondria integrate and amplify brain aging across neurons, glia, and vascular cells. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
